stories.head: Anthropic separates memory capture from memory correction
stories.fact: Anthropic describes a hierarchy of transcripts, notes, structured representations and injected context. Offline reflection, called dreaming, checks notes against original transcripts and can repair errors.
stories.why: Keep source transcripts and provenance when curating research memory; test correction of deliberately planted wrong notes.
stories.unc: Vendor experiments; reflection consumes compute and can introduce errors. Larger memory is not automatically better.
labels: Verify: check notes against source logs
Inject: keep the recurring context small
stories.alt: Conceptual labels separate transcript capture, memory curation, source verification and selective context injection.

stories.head: FRPO adds forecast supervision to portfolio-policy training
stories.fact: Foresee to Trade proposes Forecast-Augmented Relative Policy Optimization. A training-only Financial State Head learns future relative-return targets; a gate uses predictive variance and gradient alignment. Inference uses the encoder and trading policy.
stories.why: Test auxiliary forecasts against an otherwise identical policy, preserving holdings, cash constraints and transaction costs.
stories.unc: Preprint with author-reported backtests; future targets must remain inside training folds and never become inference inputs.
labels: Compare trajectories on the same path
stories.alt: Conceptual diagram labels future targets as training-only and separates them from inference-time encoder and policy.

stories.head: Cboe’s Friday snapshot records 77.97 million options contracts
stories.fact: Cboe’s market-volume summary reports 77,967,981 matched contracts across listed venue groups; Cboe venues account for 21,991,243, or 28.21%.
stories.why: Use aggregate activity to plan capacity checks, then inspect actual SPY/QQQ chain spreads and depth before execution.
stories.unc: Prior-session volume, not current liquidity or directional positioning. Snapshot time zone is not specified in the extracted table.
labels: Volume ≠ depth, direction or dealer gamma
stories.credit: Cboe Global Markets, November 6, 2026; 17:00 source checkpoint
stories.alt: Four labels show total options volume, Cboe venue volume, market share and the distinction between activity and liquidity.

stories.head: Tuesday’s CPI release is the next inflation checkpoint
stories.fact: BLS schedules October CPI for Tuesday November 10 at 8:30 a.m. Eastern, or 7:30 a.m. CST. Results are not yet available.
stories.why: Apply event-conditioned risk limits; compare headline, core and component surprises without importing unreleased values into signals.
stories.unc: Calendar event, not a forecast or released inflation reading; recheck timing before placing orders.
stories.credit: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics calendar, checked November 8, 2026
stories.alt: Calendar labels show October CPI scheduled for November 10 at 7:30 a.m. CST, with results unknown at cutoff.

stories.head: Berkshire increases buybacks as operating earnings fall
stories.fact: Berkshire reports Q3 operating earnings of $12.705 billion versus $13.485 billion a year earlier, and approximately $9.6 billion of share repurchases during the quarter.
stories.why: Separate operating performance from investment mark-to-market gains and evaluate buybacks against valuation and liquidity needs.
stories.unc: Operating earnings are non-GAAP; repurchases do not establish undervaluation. The company says the release alone is insufficient for an investment judgment.
stories.alt: Separate labels compare operating earnings across years and identify repurchases as a distinct capital-allocation measure.
